text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack web developer with 7 years of experience building fast, polished web experiences with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’d love to help with your web development and design project. I bring a strong mix of front-end build quality, UX-minded implementation, and collaborative communication, which fits well with teams that need someone who can move quickly while keeping the work organized and on schedule. I’m comfortable turning design direction into clean, responsive interfaces and making sure the final site is both visually strong and technically sound.

One project that’s especially relevant is a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, where I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. I built it with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Sanity, and Vercel, and the result was a faster, more flexible site that improved the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months.

That kind of work reflects how I approach web projects: thoughtful structure, attention to user experience, and careful execution. I focus on clear layouts, clean HTML and CSS, responsive design, and practical implementation that supports both business goals and day-to-day use by the people managing the site. I also value strong collaboration and clear communication, especially when there are multiple priorities or tight deadlines.

While I don’t claim design-tool-specific expertise beyond the development side, I do have a strong eye for translating design into production-ready pages and working closely with others to deliver a high-quality result. If you’re looking for someone who can contribute as both a developer and a reliable team partner, I’d be glad to discuss your project further.
